# Image Sources

This directory contains static images used in the blog post. All
four images are still pending generation; the prompts below are
drafted and ready to submit to Gemini (Imagen 3), following the
pattern used by the sibling post `rp-code-review-methodology`.

## hero.jpg

- **Source**: Generated with Gemini (Imagen 3)
- **License**: Generated image, no external attribution required
- **Usage**: Hero image for blog post listing and opening
- **Prompt**: an open textbook chapter on a desk with a ruler laid
  along a worked equation and a pencil resting in the gutter, soft
  natural light from the upper left, shallow depth of field on the
  worked equation, muted palette of paper cream and graphite grey
  with one warm amber accent on the pencil. Metaphor: a chapter
  drafted for a curriculum still needs one owner who can teach every
  page of it.
- **Date**: 2026-08-18

## ambiance1.jpg

- **Source**: Generated with Gemini (Imagen 3)
- **License**: Generated image, no external attribution required
- **Prompt**: a stack of graded exercise sheets on a desk with a red
  checkmark visible on the top sheet, warm overhead lighting, deep
  depth of field so the whole stack stays in focus, muted palette of
  paper white and graphite grey with one red accent from the
  checkmark. Metaphor: every exercise worked and confirmed before it
  reaches a student.
- **Date**: 2026-08-18

## ambiance2.jpg

- **Source**: Generated with Gemini (Imagen 3)
- **License**: Generated image, no external attribution required
- **Prompt**: two open textbook chapters side by side on a desk with
  a ruled index card bridging them, low raking light from the side,
  shallow depth of field on the index card with both chapters soft
  at the edges, muted palette of slate grey and cool green with one
  small copper highlight. Metaphor: checking that terms and notation
  agree from one chapter to the next.
- **Date**: 2026-08-18

## ambiance3.jpg

- **Source**: Generated with Gemini (Imagen 3)
- **License**: Generated image, no external attribution required
- **Prompt**: a chalkboard eraser resting on a stack of closed
  notebooks on a wooden desk, soft directional light from a window
  out of frame, shallow depth of field on the eraser with the
  notebooks slightly blurred, muted palette of warm wood tones and
  slate grey. Metaphor: earning the standing to teach a chapter
  rather than inheriting the draft of one.
- **Date**: 2026-08-18

## Adding Images to This Post

1. Generate each image from its prompt above using Gemini
   (Imagen 3).
2. Save image to this directory: `media/images/hero.jpg`,
   `ambiance1.jpg`, `ambiance2.jpg`, `ambiance3.jpg`.
3. Update this README.md's "Status" fields to record the
   generation date and confirm the source.
4. Images are already referenced in the post at
   `media/images/hero.jpg`, `ambiance1.jpg`, `ambiance2.jpg`, and
   `ambiance3.jpg`; no markdown changes are needed once the files
   land here.
